contract: One closure per compiled lambda AST and evaluator; shared parameter registers without save/restore; compiled let cache cells save, clear and restore around scope entry.

expressionCases.name: factory_noncaptured_identity
expressionCases.source: module M { val result={ def f(x)=List((y)=>y); Set(f(1).head(),f(2).head()).size() } }

expressionCases.name: factory_captured_identity
expressionCases.source: module M { val result={ def f(x)=List((y)=>x+y); Set(f(1).head(),f(2).head()).size() } }

expressionCases.name: distinct_factory_asts
expressionCases.source: module M { val result={ def f(x)=List((y)=>y); def g(x)=List((y)=>y); Set(f(1).head(),g(2).head()).size() } }

expressionCases.name: factory_returned_direct
expressionCases.source: module M { val result={ def f(x)=(y)=>x+y; Set(f(1),f(2)).size() } }

expressionCases.name: factory_returned_record
expressionCases.source: module M { val result={ def f(x)={g:(y)=>x+y}; Set(f(1).g,f(2).g).size() } }

expressionCases.name: factory_returned_map
expressionCases.source: module M { val result={ def f(x)=Map((0,(y)=>x+y)); Set(f(1).get(0),f(2).get(0)).size() } }

expressionCases.name: factory_returned_variant
expressionCases.source: module M { val result={ def f(x)=variant("F",(y)=>x+y); val a=match f(1) { F(g)=>g }; val b=match f(2) { F(g)=>g }; Set(a,b).size() } }

expressionCases.name: same_branch_ast
expressionCases.source: module M { val result={ def f(x)=if(x>0) (y)=>x+y else (y)=>x-y; Set(f(1),f(2)).size() } }

expressionCases.name: distinct_branch_asts
expressionCases.source: module M { val result={ def f(x)=if(x>0) (y)=>x+y else (y)=>x-y; Set(f(1),f(0)).size() } }

expressionCases.name: latest_outer_parameter
expressionCases.source: module M { val result={ def f(x)=(y)=>x+y; val fs=List(f(10),f(20)); val a=fs.head(); val b=fs.nth(1); List(a(1),b(2)) } }

expressionCases.name: latest_outer_parameter_collection
expressionCases.source: module M { val result={ def f(x)=List((y)=>x+y); val fs=List(f(10).head(),f(20).head()); val a=fs.head(); val b=fs.nth(1); List(a(1),b(2)) } }

expressionCases.name: nested_factory_parameters
expressionCases.source: module M { val result={ def f(x)=(y)=>(z)=>x+y+z; val fs=List(f(10),f(20)); val a=fs.head(); val b=fs.nth(1); val gs=List(a(100),b(200)); val c=gs.head(); val d=gs.nth(1); List(c(1),d(2)) } }

expressionCases.name: local_lazy_value_capture
expressionCases.source: module M { val result={ def f(x)={ val z=x*2; (y)=>z+y }; val fs=List(f(10),f(20)); val a=fs.head(); val b=fs.nth(1); List(a(1),b(2)) } }

expressionCases.name: factory_calls_via_map
expressionCases.source: module M { val result={ def f(x)=List((y)=>x+y); val fs=Set(10,20).mapBy(x=>f(x).head()); val a=fs.get(10); val b=fs.get(20); List(a(1),b(2)) } }

expressionCases.name: factory_calls_via_list_fold
expressionCases.source: module M { val result={ def f(x)=List((y)=>x+y); val fs=List(10,20).foldl(List(),(a,x)=>a.append(f(x).head())); val a=fs.head(); val b=fs.nth(1); List(a(1),b(2)) } }

sessions.name: lazy_local_capture
sessions.source: module M { def factory(x)={ val z=x*2; List((y)=>z+y) } }

sessions.name: eager_local_capture
sessions.source: module M { def factory(x)={ val z=x*2; List((y)=>z+y,z) } }
